Thanks Marissa — Tue 4/6 10:00–11:30 works best for me. Please book that.

On the bar-raiser side, I prefer Markus to join the debrief only (so we don't bias the candidate), and for interviewers to hit the following focus areas:
- Interview 1 (Logan): system design for low-latency multi-tenant inference, capacity planning tradeoffs.
- Interview 2 (Hannah): runtime/kernel decisions, quantization impacts, debugging perf regressions.
- Interview 3 (Diego): cross-team ownership, prioritization under resource constraints, shipping tradeoffs.

For the debrief, propose a 40m interviewers-only + 10m final consensus model: 20m signal + 20m rubric calibration + 10m hire/no-hire call. Markus, can you confirm the bar anchors you want us to use? I'll prepare a 1-page prompt set for the interviewers and a post-interview checklist (time-box debrief, anchor notes).

If anyone needs to swap slots, flag by EOD Monday.

Diego
Senior Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-04-02T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Alex Chen (Sr Serving Eng) - bar-raiser anchors

Diego / team — thanks for the heads-up. I can attend the debrief only (good call on avoiding bias). High-level bar-raiser anchors I expect:

1) Deep ownership: candidate can point to a shipped project end-to-end, decisions they made, and how they measured success (look for tradeoffs and follow-through).
2) Systems intuition + tradeoffs: latency/throughput vs cost, batching strategies, KV cache behavior, and when to favor heuristics vs algorithmic changes.
3) Debugging under pressure: clear troubleshooting steps, metrics to inspect first, and effective mitigations.
4) Cross-functional influence: can they drive prioritization without direct authority? examples preferred.

Suggested debrief rubric (brief):
- Hireability (1-5), Ownership (1-5), Technical depth (1-5), Communication (1-5).
- Red flag bucket: repeated evasions, no measurable outcomes, poor collaboration history.

I'll attach a short anchor doc and two example debrief questions to feed into the packet. Please ensure interviewers write 3x bullets of signal immediately after the interview (no editing later) — that's been critical in past sessions.

Attachments: bar_raiser_anchor.pdf

Markus
Staff Engineering (Bar Raiser)
